profile: Swedencare AB (publ) develops, produces, and sells premium pet health products for dogs, cats, and horses. Its portfolio includes dental care, supplements, topicals, treats, and veterinary-formulated products under brands such as ProDen PlaqueOff®, NaturVet®, Innovet, Pet MD®, Rx Vitamins®, and others. The company sells through veterinarians, pet stores, and online channels across international markets.
